name: SciSpace
description: Discover, read, and analyze 280M+ scientific research papers directly from Claude. SciSpace turns Claude into your AI research assistant — run question-aware semantic search across peer-reviewed literature, pull full abstracts with citations, and add AI-generated columns for methods, results, limitations, datasets, and more. Built for researchers conducting literature reviews, background research, and meta-analyses — bring scientific knowledge into your AI workflow, with every result linked back to the original paper.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SciSpace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SciSpace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://scispace.com/mcp-kls34hjb.

_published_faq.name: Is SciSpace MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, SciSpace scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SciSpace MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SciSpace provides these MCP tools: search-papers and add-column.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SciSpace?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SciSpace in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
SciSpace does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is SciSpace failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: SciSpace scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
SciSpace is developed by PubGenius Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
